Overview

About

The AI for Good Hackathon – 2nd Edition is a purpose-driven CSR initiative that brings together passionate problem-solvers, engineers, and data enthusiasts to build AI-powered solutions for real-world impact.

Over an intensive 24-hour hackathon, participants will collaborate in teams to design, prototype, and present solutions that address meaningful challenges across domains such as sustainability, social good, accessibility, and efficiency.

This hackathon goes beyond just coding—it’s about applying AI thoughtfully and responsibly to solve problems that matter. While the core mission is driving social change, Blend India is actively investing in top talent. Exceptional builders who demonstrate high execution skills during the event will gain direct visibility for full-time career pathways and placement opportunities within Blend India.

Participants will get the opportunity to:

  • Work on impactful, real-world problem statements.
  • Leverage AI/ML tools, data, and creativity to build for the community.
  • Collaborate, experiment, and innovate under time constraints.
  • Present solutions directly to a panel of Blend leaders and industry experts.
  • Explore potential career opportunities and full-time roles based on performance on the floor.

Whether it’s improving lives, optimizing systems, or enabling smarter decisions, this hackathon is a platform to turn ideas into meaningful outcomes.

Themes

Optimizing donor-patient matching using AI

Blood Warriors is a foundation connecting voluntary blood donors with Thalassemia patients across India. With over 1,00,000 patients requiring up to 500 to 700 transfusions in a lifetime, the demand for reliable, recurring, and compatible blood is constant. Their Blood Bridge initiative and donor network are at the heart of making this happen. Current Challenges: • Matching donors to patients relies heavily on manual effort • Coordinating requests across multiple stakeholders is complex • Maintaining engagement within the ecosystem is difficult • Scaling across cities and partner organizations is hard to sustain AI-Enabled Care Coordination and Access: • Make it easier for different people involved in care to stay connected and informed at the right time • Enable intuitive and adaptive interactions across languages and contexts • Build systems that can remember and respond appropriately over repeated interactions Smart Matching and Resource Allocation: • Identify and prioritize the right donors or resources when needs arise • Use signals or patterns to anticipate availability or willingness to participate Engagement and Continuity: • Encourage continued participation from donors and contributors • Build long-term engagement mechanisms • Create feedback loops that make the system feel responsive and human Operating at Scale: • Design systems that work across a large, diverse population • Adapt to variations in language, accessibility, and infrastructure • Ensure efficiency while expanding to multiple users and regions simultaneously

Eligibility

Participants must adhere to the following eligibility criteria. Failure to comply will lead to disqualification.

Open to immediate joiners from graduation years 2024 to 2026. Participation is allowed individually or in teams of up to 2 members.

Rules

Participants must adhere to the following guidelines. Failure to comply will lead to disqualification.

1. Live Development

  • All solutions must be developed entirely during the hackathon.
  • Any pre-existing projects or reuse of past code is strictly prohibited.

2. Data Privacy

  • Any data provided by Blend360 during the event is confidential.
  • It must not be stored, shared, or used beyond the hackathon period.

3. Open Source

  • Participants are allowed to use open-source libraries or APIs.
  • These must be explicitly disclosed during the idea submission phase.

4. Deadlines

  • Teams must submit their projects before the stipulated deadline.
  • Late submissions will not be considered under any circumstances.

5. Zero Plagiarism

  • Any form of plagiarism will lead to immediate and final disqualification.

6. Code of Conduct

  • All participants must strictly adhere to the Buildora Code of Conduct.
  • Organizers reserve the right to take necessary actions, including warnings or disqualification, to ensure a safe, inclusive, and fair environment for all.

7. Final Authority

  • The organizing team reserves the right to modify the rules if necessary (participants will be notified).
  • Any disputes will be handled at the discretion of the hackathon organizers, and their decision is final.
